question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-4) × 6
solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-4) × 6

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS): Brackets, Orders (powers), Division/Multiplication (left to right), Addition/Subtraction (left to right)

**Calculations:**

Expression: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (- 4) × 6

⇒ (-9) - (-60 ÷ -15) + (-4 × 6)

⇒ (- 9) - (4) + (-24)

⇒ - 9 - 4 - 24

⇒ -37

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
